Why you need this

Your Agents Will Hallucinate. Do Not Let Them Execute.

An LLM hallucinating a fact is a bug. An LLM hallucinating a $5,000 refund, a production migration, or a customer email is a crisis. Forsig gives your agents autonomy with a brake pedal.

$5,000 refundSupport agent invents a refund policy and tries to issue money.
VIP customer emailSales agent sends a fake discount promise to an enterprise lead.
Database updateOps agent runs a destructive command in production.
SDK

Agent-Native Human-in-the-Loop.

Forsig returns a structured decision your workflow can branch on. It is not a chat ping, a fragile Slack bot, or a human-readable message your agent has to guess how to interpret.

Visual architecture

A live checkpoint layer between agents and real-world actions

Your agent does not execute the risky action directly. It calls Forsig with the proposed action, risk reason, and minimal context. A human decides. Your agent receives a structured decision and either continues, modifies the action, stops, or hands control to a human.

Forsig risk policy matched

Why Forsig

Your Slack approval bot will fail when the agent needs a state machine.

Slack is good for notifications. Forsig is built for agent control: durable pauses, signed decisions, fail-closed timeouts, and a response your workflow can branch on.

Slack approvalForsig approval
Human-readable chatMachine-readable decision
Easy to missTimeout and fail-closed behavior
Stateless messagesDurable pending escalation
Hard to auditProposal, reviewer, decision, timestamp
Weak workflow controlSigned webhook handoff
Decision model

The exact states your agent branches on

Approve and reject are only the start. Forsig gives reviewers practical options that map directly to workflow behavior.

ApprovedHuman accepted the action.Agent continues.
RejectedHuman blocked the action.Agent stops.
EditedReviewer changed the instruction.Agent continues with the modified plan.
TakeoverHuman owns the task now.Agent stops or hands off.
Needs more infoReviewer asks the agent to gather context.Agent escalates again later.
TimeoutNo decision before expiry.Fail closed by default.
Minimal context

Send only what a reviewer needs

Forsig is designed for small, decision-focused payloads. Avoid secrets, API keys, passwords, full payment details, and unnecessary personal data.

{
  "agent": "refund-agent",
  "action": "stripe.refund",
  "amount": 500,
  "risk": "refund_over_limit",
  "reason": "Refund exceeds policy threshold",
  "customer_tier": "VIP"
}
Security model

Built for safe agent handoff

Forsig is built around explicit human decisions, scoped access, minimal context sharing, and fail-closed behavior. No compliance certifications are claimed yet.

Fail closedIf no reviewer responds, return timeout or rejected. Minimal contextSend only fields needed for review. Signed webhooksVerify decisions before trusting them. Scoped API keysSeparate keys by workflow, agent, or environment. Audit trailRecord proposal, reviewer, decision, edited instruction, and time. Explicit approvalNo silent continuation for sensitive actions. Fail closedIf no reviewer responds, return timeout or rejected. Minimal contextSend only fields needed for review. Signed webhooksVerify returned decisions before trusting them. Scoped API keysSeparate keys by workflow, agent, or environment.
